Card Q&A.q: Does this card’s [On Play] effect activate when my opponent has no Digimon in their battle area?

Effect: [On Play] Trash the bottom 3 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if your opponent has no Digimon with digivolution cards, you may play 1 blue Tamer card from your hand without paying the cost.
